cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Just us for lunch. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. We learned an audience makes us compete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter just asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. We're already applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out to get a turn.

mechanism: A professionally reduces the format of a shared meal, reframing a failed family reunion as useful evidence that the relationship works better without an audience.
confusable: D65 frames losses as chosen generosity; D89 claims the rupture itself helped improve their connection.
comparison: Coffee alternative accepts independent schedules; lunch alternative applies a two-person format after group conflict.
seedUse: Failed reunion, everyone leaving, waiter expecting more and two-person lunch derive from D89-b; S03 makes headcount and format correction explicit.
